        🚀 INAI • The Open AI Hub

        ⭐ If you like this project, please star it on GitHub — it helps a lot! ⭐

        Maintained by Sandeep Karnati •
        Latest updates 👉 inai.wiki

        📖 See CONTRIBUTING.md for step-by-step instructions.

        🌍 INAI • The Open AI Hub

        ⭐ Star this repo to support the open Wikipedia of AI ⭐
        2M+ apps, agents, MCP servers, LLMs, Chrome extensions, tutorials & daily news — free & open

        ✨ What is INAI?

        INAI = Intelligence Atlas — the open, ever-growing Wikipedia of AI.
        Not just a blog or a list; it’s a living map of the AI ecosystem.

        • 📰 AI News Daily → curated from 250+ sources & 500+ experts
        • 🛠️ Apps & Tools → 2M+ product entries indexed
        • 🤖 Agents → frameworks, platforms, productivity bots
        • 🧩 MCP Servers → Model Context Protocol ecosystem
        • 🧪 Chrome Extensions → AI-powered browsing add-ons
        • 🧠 LLMs & Models → Hugging Face, fine-tunes, evals
        • 📚 Tutorials & Guides → reproducible workflows & how-tos
        • 🎙️ Podcast → AI News Daily on Spotify & Apple

        🔎 Explore INAI

        News & Updates

        • 📰 AI News Daily → Curated daily AI news from 250+ sources & experts.
        • 🐦 Twitter AI Digest → Latest AI trends & discussions from 500+ AI Users on Twitter/X
        • 📢 Reddit AI Highlights → Top AI posts & debates from Reddit communities
        • 💻 Hacker News (AI) → Popular AI projects & research on Hacker News.
        • 🗓️ Weekly Archives → A complete weekly archive of AI tools & news.

        Applications & Knowledge

        • 🛠️ AI Apps & Tools - Browse AI apps, tools, and open-source projects.
        • 🤖 AI Agents - Discover the latest AI agents, workflows, and productivity bots.
        • 🧩 MCP Servers - Index of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for AI integration.
        • 🧪 Chrome Extensions - Curated list of AI-powered Chrome extensions.
        • 🧠 LLMs & Models - Comprehensive LLM database: open-source models, fine-tunes, benchmarks.
        • 📚 Tutorials & Guides - Step-by-step AI tutorials, workflows, and educational material.

        🔥 Recently Added

        We add new content daily — fresh apps, agents, and LLMs to keep you ahead.

        ➡️ See the Latest Additions

        💡 Got something new? Submit it here

        INAI’s 2M+ AI Database is alive and growing — every day.

        💎 Why INAI?

        • 🌍 Global → apps, models, datasets, research, tutorials
        • 🕑 Real-time → refreshed daily
        • 📈 Scale → 2,000,000+ resources indexed
        • 🎯 Curated → tagged, summarized, de-duplicated
        • 💡 Free & Open → non-commercial, attribution required

        🎧 Podcast

        • 🎙️ AI News Daily Podcast

        📅 Roadmap

        • ✅ Daily AI News + Weekly archives
        • 🚀 Public release of Apps/Tools Directory
        • 🚀 Expansion: Agents, MCP Servers, Chrome Extensions, LLMs
        • 🚀 Showcase: Latest Additions (auto-updated feeds)
        • 🚧 Public API & Global Search
